The PR pane now finds a GitLab merge request when the local branch was pushed under a different name.

- When a local branch tracks a remote branch with another name (for example a `worktree-fix-…` branch pushed as `fix/…`), the PR pane looks up the merge request by the upstream branch, so it no longer says "No open PR or MR" for an open one. GitHub already followed the upstream
- desk-asana, desk-slack, desk-plan and desk-grant move to 0.72.1 with no changes

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
